title: One More Morning in the Dolomites
route: Selva di Val Gardena → Val di Funes → Brescia
introTitle: One last morning in the mountains.
intro: After waking up in Selva di Val Gardena, the trip takes a slower pace for one more morning in the Dolomites. The route heads toward Val di Funes and Santa Maddalena for another classic Alpine landscape before leaving the mountains behind and returning to Brescia.

stops.name: Selva di Val Gardena
stops.description: Begin the morning in the heart of Val Gardena before heading toward Val di Funes.

stops.name: Santa Maddalena — Val di Funes
stops.description: Spend part of the morning in Val di Funes, surrounded by the dramatic Odle peaks and classic Dolomite scenery.

stops.name: Brescia
stops.description: Leave the Dolomites behind and return to Brescia for the next stretch of the journey.
